summary: Change lands in the ShortLink entity, link creation, redirect resolution and link details
rationale: The limit is a property of a link (domain + table), set at creation (request, validator, service) and enforced where redirects are resolved; details expose it.
risks: Schema change on ShortLinks: needs an EF Core migration (human approval) that existing rows survive.
Redirects are served from IMemoryCache, whose cached ClickCount is stale; enforcement must not trust it.
Idempotency fingerprints hash the serialized request; a new field would change fingerprints of keys stored before deployment.
Clicks are recorded asynchronously, so concurrent redirects can exceed the limit slightly.
